content: Two types of persons annotated Annodis: linguistic experts and students. The first group constituted a $E$ subcorpus called “specialist” and the second group resulted in a $N$ subcorpus called “naive”. These rhetorically annotated subcorps were used as references in our experiments. (c.f. §SECREF6).
